name: mzTab-M 2.1.0-M Default Profile
description: Baseline HUPO-PSI mzTab-M 2.1.0-M Default Profile defining minimum structural, metadata, controlled vocabulary, and cross-section OPA integrity requirements for valid mzTab-M documents

requirements.description: Global cross-section OPA policy rules validating abundance column counts and cross-entity identifier referential integrity across the mzTab-M document

Verifies that abundance column counts in smallMoleculeSummary and smallMoleculeFeature match the number of assays and study variables declared in metadata (abundance_assay vs metadata.assay; abundance_study_variable and abundance_variation_study_variable vs metadata.study_variable)

Checks that required identifier and reference fields across metadata and table sections (id, sml_id, smf_id, sme_id, instrument_ref, sample_ref, ms_run_refs, group_refs, assay_refs, spectra_ref.ms_run) are defined and non-null

Verifies referential integrity by checking that all cross-referenced IDs (instrument_ref, sample_ref, ms_run_refs, group_refs, assay_refs, smf_id_refs, sme_id_refs, spectra_ref.ms_run) resolve to existing target items

Checks that all declared target entities (instrument, sample, ms_run, study_variable_group, assay, smallMoleculeFeature, smallMoleculeEvidence) are referenced by at least one corresponding reference field in the mzTab-M document

$.description: Root-level structural requirements for a valid HUPO-PSI mzTab-M 2.1.0-M document

requirements.description: Root mzTab-M document MUST contain the metadata section and is recommended to include smallMoleculeSummary

$.comment[*].description: Each comment entry prefix MUST equal 'COM'

value_constraint.description: Comment line number must be a positive integer (>= 1) or null

$.metadata.description: Metadata section MUST be present and define all mandatory mzTab-M 2.1.0-M properties (prefix, mzTab-version, mzTab-ID, quantification_method, ms_run, assay, study_variable, cv, database, small_molecule-quantification_unit, id_confidence_measure), and is recommended to define contact, publication, software, and sample

$.metadata.prefix.description: Metadata prefix MUST be present and equal 'MTD'

value_constraint.description: Metadata prefix must match the literal string 'MTD'

$.metadata.mzTab-version.description: Metadata mzTab-version MUST be present and follow the version format 'X.Y.Z-M' (e.g. '2.1.0-M')

value_constraint.description: mzTab-version must match pattern ^\d{1}\.\d{1}\.\d{1}-[A-Z]{1}$

constraint.description: Checks whether publication item type equals 'doi'

requirements.description: When publication item type is 'uri', accession MUST be a valid URI
